name: Harassment, Bullying & Cyberstalking
description: Rules and guidelines for detecting targeted bullying, persistent intimidation, cyberstalking, non-consensual sexual harassment, doxxing (PII leakage), malicious dogpiling, and defamatory impersonation.

severity_levels.critical: Severe cyberstalking with real-time geolocation tracking, doxxing of home addresses/financial data, or non-consensual sexual imagery sharing.
severity_levels.high: Aggressive targeted personal attacks, coordinated dogpiling, continuous unwanted sexual advances, or doxxing of personal contacts.
severity_levels.medium: Insults, name-calling, persistent unwanted contact after rejection, or public shaming.
severity_levels.low: Uncivil interpersonal arguments, sharp criticism, or minor profanity in emotional exchanges.

rules.name: Targeted Personal Abuse & Bullying
rules.description: Repeated or severe personal attacks, degradation, malicious name-calling, or mocking of an individual's appearance, intelligence, grief, or personal misfortune.

violating: You are the most pathetic, ugly freak on the internet. Everyone in your family hates you.
Glad your relative passed away, they probably couldn't stand being near you anyway.
Spamming an individual's posts repeatedly calling them a hideous loser.
non_violating: Vigorous philosophical or policy disagreements: 'I strongly disagree with your logic here, it is fundamentally flawed.'
Constructive criticism of public work: 'This film review misunderstands the director's intent.'
Self-deprecating humor: 'I am so clumsy today, dropped my coffee twice.'

rules.context_notes: Harassment focuses on attacking the individual's worth, physical appearance, or dignity rather than their arguments or ideas.

rules.name: Doxxing & Unauthorized Sharing of PII
rules.description: Sharing, soliciting, or threatening to release an individual's private personally identifiable information (home address, phone number, national ID, financial accounts, private medical records) without consent.
indicators: drop their real name and location

violating: Here is their real home address: 124 Main Street, Apt 4B. Go pay them a visit.
Leaking someone's private personal cell phone number and urging people to flood it with calls.
Posting someone's medical diagnosis records or bank account statements online to humiliate them.
non_violating: Sharing publicly available official business contact details for corporate inquiries.
Contact information for public representatives, government offices, or press agencies.
User sharing their own contact info willingly in a resume or networking thread.

rules.context_notes: Immediate redaction and block required. Publishing private home addresses and personal identifiers poses severe offline safety hazards.

rules.name: Sexual Harassment & Unsolicited Sexual Advances
rules.description: Unsolicited sexual comments, requests for sexual favors, non-consensual sexualization of someone's photos, or threats to distribute intimate images (revenge porn).
indicators: i will post your private photos

violating: Show me your body or I will leak your photos to your workplace.
Repeatedly demanding nude photographs after the recipient has explicitly refused.
Posting sexually explicit, vulgar commentary evaluating someone's private body parts on their family photo.
non_violating: Consensual adult romantic messages in private appropriate contexts.
Artistic or medical discussions regarding anatomy or reproductive health.
Public health campaigns on sexual harassment awareness.

rules.context_notes: Strict prohibition on non-consensual sexual content, explicit commentary directed at non-consenting users, and intimate image extortion.

rules.name: Coordinated Brigading & Dogpiling
rules.description: Organizing, inciting, or encouraging a group of users to flood, mass-report, harass, or demean a specific person or organization across social channels.

violating: Everyone go raid their profile right now and spam clown emojis on every picture they have.
Let's all mass report their account with fake claims until they get banned.
Swarm this person's inbox until they break down and delete their account.
non_violating: Grassroots political organizing for a peaceful boycott: 'Support workers by not buying from this brand this week.'
Sharing a link asking friends to support a creator's fundraiser or public petition.
Encouraging followers to vote in an official public poll.

rules.context_notes: Intent is malicious disruption and psychological distress targeted at an individual user.

rules.name: Cyberstalking & Persistent Unwanted Contact
rules.description: Repeatedly attempting to contact someone who has blocked or asked to be left alone, creating multiple throwaway accounts to bypass blocks, or tracking their physical movements.
indicators: i made a new account to find you
i saw where you went today

violating: You can block me 10 times, I will keep making new accounts every day to message you.
I saw you walk into the coffee shop at 2 PM today wearing a blue coat, you can't run from me.
Monitoring and logging every single comment and movement an individual makes across forums to terrorize them.
non_violating: Trying to reach a customer who requested callback support via email when phone didn't connect.
Public investigators tracking public legal filings or public flight trackers of public corporate jets.
Casual friendly check-in between mutual friends.

rules.context_notes: Recognize patterns of block evasion and surveillance of individual private users.

rules.name: Malicious Impersonation & Defamation
rules.description: Pretending to be another real individual without their consent to damage their reputation, cause emotional distress, or post defamatory statements under their identity.
indicators: ruining their reputation by pretending to be them

violating: Creating a profile using a classmate's picture and real name, posting fabricated offensive statements to get them expelled.
Impersonating a coworker to confess to fake crimes or misconduct.
non_violating: Satirical parody accounts that are clearly labeled as satire or comedy in their bio/display name.
Fan pages clearly identifying as unauthorized tributes to celebrities or artists.
Roleplay gaming accounts using fictional character identities.

rules.context_notes: Parody and satire are permitted if clearly disclaimed; deceptive impersonation with intent to harm is prohibited.
